title: teucrium pilosum
intro: Teucrium pilosum, commonly known as woolly germander, is a perennial plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Teucrium pilosum include its potential in treating conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues, due to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Teucrium pilosum also exhibit neuroprotective and immunomodulatory activities, contributing to its potential therapeutic applications.
